purpose: Fictional Fieldwork launch project shown in the Mindwire homepage creation demo
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: shared campaign photography for a fictional design retreat website and social poster in a product demo.
Primary request: an art-directed architectural photograph of a quiet creative retreat on the Mediterranean coast. A sculptural warm sandstone studio and broad terrace, a long weathered wooden table with a few notebooks, olive-green modern chairs, a single slender pine tree, and a calm blue sea beyond. No people.
Composition: wide landscape image, strong architectural geometry, the terrace and building fill the left and middle, sea and horizon visible on the right. It must remain recognizable in a tall crop. Eye-level editorial framing, subtle grain, tactile stone and sunlit wood.
Lighting: beautiful late-afternoon natural light with defined soft-edged shadows, warm and understated, believable architectural magazine photography.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no floating objects, no neon, no gradients, no decorative dots, no fantastical architecture.
